steps.title: Locate the muscle observed by ultrasound
steps.explanation: The recorded trial’s ultrasound channel observes brachioradialis thickness. Isolate the atlas brachioradialis to learn the anatomical name, while keeping the datasets separate: this surface is not a scan of participant 2.
steps.observe: The selected reference is brachioradialis with 3,270 vertices and 4,874 triangles. Subject registration remains false; the atlas does not deform to the trace.

steps.title: A second signal can concern a different muscle
steps.explanation: The trial’s sEMG channel concerns biceps brachii. This selected long-head atlas surface is an anatomical illustration, not localization of the electrode or an isolation of that head’s signal. The recorded values are normalized unit-one quantities, not activation or individual-muscle force.
steps.observe: The display changes to the long biceps head. There is no conversion from the normalized recording into this surface’s force or deformation.

steps.title: Read three evidence streams without joining them
steps.explanation: The chapter’s recorded curves, six Arm26 actuator parameter sets and ten atlas surfaces answer different questions. The recording uses 4,403 irregularly timed samples and 172 half-second display bins; its held 90° posture is not a measured angle trajectory. Read the existing plots and source tables below alongside the unregistered atlas.
steps.observe: All atlas parts return. No synchronization, participant-specific fit or Newton-valued force is inferred from the normalized recording.

audit.finding: The chapter adapter displayed only an atlas, which could make the independent recording and model parameters look like inputs to one anatomy model.
audit.change: Worked part selections tie the two named signal modalities to their stated anatomical scope and preserve the existing recording plots and Arm26 table as independent evidence.
audit.remaining: The embedded panel does not add interactive recording scrubbing or model-parameter fitting. Physical-unit calibration, electrode localization and cross-dataset registration remain absent.
